sop_thesis: **Wolverine World Wide (WWW)** operates in Consumer Discretionary (Shoe Manufacturing) with an established market capitalization of $1.74B. The company maintains a confirmed Narrow Moat backed by Brand Equity, Omnichannel Logistics Scale & Customer Loyalty. Long-term valuation metrics model an intrinsic DCF fair value of $23.62 (18.0% margin of safety). Systematic tranche entry is recommended at $19.62 (Tranche 1), $18.42 (Tranche 2), and $17.02 (Tranche 3).
